legal_mentions.cfdi_not_stamped: This document is not a Comprobante Fiscal Digital por Internet (CFDI): it carries neither the fiscal folio nor the digital seal of the Tax Administration Service assigned by an authorised certification provider. Only the stamped CFDI supports the transaction for tax purposes.
legal_mentions.cfdi_ppd: Payment in instalments or deferred (PPD): each collection is supported by a CFDI with the payment receipt complement, and the value added tax charged falls due when the consideration is actually collected.
legal_mentions.export: Export — value added tax at 0 % (article 29 of the Value Added Tax Act).
legal_mentions.exempt: Act or activity exempt from value added tax (articles 9, 15 or 20 of the Value Added Tax Act, depending on the act).
